title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Payoff Autopay: Deferred-Interest Balance, Plan Dates and Fixed Draft
content:
**Fixed draft amount.** On a Ridgeline Consumer Credit card, the fixed draft amount of an autopay plan that pays off the deferred-interest balance is the deferred-interest balance increased by 5 percent and divided by the number of the plan's due dates, rounded up to the next whole dollar. Where no due date remains, the division is by 1.

**Deferred-interest balance.** The posted amount of every purchase on a 6, 12 or 24 month deferred-interest plan, less every return credit carrying one of those plan codes, less every payment the account records as allocated to a deferred-interest balance at the cardholder's request or within a promotion's expiry window, each such payment counted at its full amount, and never below zero. Purchases on 84 fixed monthly payments and on the standard plan are not part of it.

**Plan's end date.** The earliest, across the deferred-interest plans the account carries, of the promotional end date of the most recently posted purchase on that plan.

**Plan's due dates.** The monthly payment due dates on the same day of the month as the latest statement's due date, from the first one after today through the plan's end date; the latest statement's due date itself counts only when it falls after today.

**Rounding up.** A figure with any cents goes up to the next whole dollar (199.01 becomes 200.00); a figure already in whole dollars stays as it is (200.00 stays 200.00).

## Worked example (hypothetical card)

- 12-month deferred-interest purchases posted: 2400.00, the latest posted 15 January 2026 with a promotional end date of 15 January 2027; no other deferred-interest plan.
- Return credits carrying the 12-month plan: 200.00. Payments recorded as allocated to the deferred-interest balance: 300.00.
- Deferred-interest balance: 2400.00 less 200.00 less 300.00, that is 1900.00.
- Latest statement's due date 10 March 2026; today 12 March 2026. Due dates: 10 April 2026 through 10 January 2027, that is 10 (10 February 2027 is after the end date; 10 March 2026 is not after today).
- 1900.00 increased by 5 percent is 1995.00; divided by 10 is 199.50; rounded up, the fixed draft amount is 200.00.

Had today been 5 March 2026, the latest due date of 10 March 2026 would fall after today and count: 11 due dates, 1995.00 divided by 11 is 181.36..., rounded up 182.00.

## Plan end date across plans (hypothetical)

| Plan | Promotional end date of its most recently posted purchase |
|---|---|
| 6-month deferred interest | 20 August 2026 |
| 12-month deferred interest | 15 January 2027 |

The plan's end date is 20 August 2026, the earlier of the two.
